title: SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.31101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speaking early turns a prediction into an irreversible public commitment. We introduce SayWhen, a test-time controller that selects a task-directed act shared across typed continuation plans and controls its release as speech. A persistent veto blocks playback when intervening transcripts invalidate the candidate. We define regret-free early speech (RFES) to measure supported pre-endpoint releases without scored incompatibility. On a 72-prefix branching diagnostic, the generated-plan frontier attains 6.0% RFES with zero observed mean regret, versus 8.2% RFES and 0.068 regret for Matched Top-One. Measured planner latency constrains this path; a deterministic retail schema attains 31.7% RFES, compared with 32.0% for the complete policy. In a separate 30-task $\tau$-Voice simulation, schema-derived candidates with cached text-to-speech (TTS) audio attain 21/30 task-level RFES. Eligible audio begins 1.51 seconds before the user-audio endpoin

translated_title: SayWhen：面向低悔憾早期语音的集合值语义承诺
translated_abstract: 提前说话会将预测转变为不可撤销的公开承诺。我们提出SayWhen，这是一个测试时控制器，它在类型化续写计划之间选择一个共享的任务导向行动，并控制其作为语音的释放。当中间转录使候选失效时，持久否决机制会阻止播放。我们定义了无悔憾早期语音（RFES）来衡量有支持的、且无评分不兼容的端点前语音发布。在72前缀分支诊断中，生成计划前沿达到6.0%的RFES且观测平均悔憾为零，相比之下Matched Top-One为8.2% RFES和0.068悔憾。实测规划器延迟限制了该路径；确定性零售模式达到31.7%的RFES，相比之下完整策略为32.0%。在单独的30任务τ-Voice模拟中，基于模式导出且缓存文本转语音（TTS）音频的候选达到21/30的任务级RFES。合格音频在用户音频端点前1.51秒开始。
tldr: 该论文提出SayWhen测试时控制器，通过集合值语义承诺与持久否决机制实现低悔憾的早期语音发布，并定义无悔憾早期语音（RFES）指标，在分支诊断、零售模式和τ-Voice模拟中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SayWhen, a test-time controller enabling low-regret early speech through set-valued semantic commitment and persistent veto, introducing the Regret-Free Early Speech (RFES) metric validated across branching diagnostics, retail schemas, and τ-Voice simulations.
